intro: A place of Buddhist practice, compassionate service, and support for the Sangha in the sacred city of Anuradhapura.
aboutTitle: A Place of Service and Dhamma
aboutText: Established on 15 June 2024 at Pandulagama, Anuradhapura, by Bhante Seelananda, with the support of the Management Committee of Mangala Vihara Buddhist Temple, Singapore. The Centre welcomes Buddhist monks and pilgrims visiting the ancient Buddhist sites of Sri Lanka.
vision: To create a place where the Buddha Dhamma, compassionate service, and support for the Sangha come together — serving visiting monks and the local community while strengthening Buddhist values for future generations.
